title: Play AC Online events file (api 2)
description: Dated town days with safe effects only: a notice on the town bulletin board, posted once on the day in the player's own town (never on a visit or in the City; needs scope world), villager lines for the day, ahead of talk pools, and a letter from the same mod's letters file, mailed once on the day to the player's mailbox in their own town (never on a visit or in the City), counted against the mod's daily letter cap, with no script. No decorations: the game has no data seam for them. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

date.description: {month, day} (February 29 works) or {month, week 1 to 4 or "last", weekday 0 Sunday to 6}.

board.description: A bulletin board notice: 1 to 192 characters on at most 6 lines. Plain text: printable ASCII, no { or }. Needs scope world.

items.description: A villager line: 1 to 160 characters, at most 3 line breaks.

letter.description: The id of a letter in this mod's letters file, mailed on the day: once per town per day, the first time the player is free in their own town, through the same rules as cmd.send_letter (mailbox, else the post office; counted against the daily letter cap). No permission or script needed.
